messages:
sara (release-lead): starting gradual canary for release v3.2.1 -> prod-east. 10% traffic, models pinned to redwood-v3-2026. pinging monitoring + oncall. deploybot: kicking off canary :rocket:

deploybot: canary created (id=cb-1765604321). targets: svc-llm-prod-east, routing=10%. health checks enabled.

ajay (serving): watching tail latency and 5xx. will post if we see anything >0.5% in 5m window.

kelly (oncall): noted. if 5xx >1% sustained for 2m or avg p95 rises >50ms across webtier -> invoke lifeline unwind (see runbook). tagging ops-runbook-bot for quick links.

ops-runbook-bot: rollback-lifeline runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-lifeline (internal). quick commands:
```
# reduce canary to 0
redwoodctl rollout set --id cb-1765604321 --percent 0 --reason "lifeline unwind"
# pin traffic to fallback model
redwoodctl routing set --service svc-llm-prod-east --model redwood-ocelot-v1 --weight 100
# clear prefix caches if model mismatch
redwoodctl cache purge --service svc-llm-prod-east --prefixes "session-*"
```

mike (platform): added checklist to the runbook with owner handoff steps and runbook escalation matrix. link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-lifeline#checklist

ajay (serving): seeing a small uptick in token latency but 5xx still ~0.2%. p95 increased by ~30ms in the last 3m, not past our threshold yet. attaching quick trace: https://spans.redwood/trace/1765604321

kelly (oncall): if it creeps to p95 +60ms and error rate hits 0.8% mark, move to soft-unpin then lifeline. soft-unpin = reduce new-deploys, fail fast smearing via header: `x-rw-failover:soft` to divert new sessions.

sara (release-lead): agreed. plan: wait 10m, if metrics cross thresholds we'll do lifeline unwind and notify customers. if it's stable we continue to 25% at +30m.

(5m later) deploybot: metric alert: canary cb-1765604321 5xx rate = 1.2% over 2m, p95 +78ms. alerting channel and oncall.

kelly (oncall): initiating lifeline unwind now. calling out owners: @ajay @mike. running commands.

ajay (serving): running `redwoodctl rollout set --id cb-1765604321 --percent 0 --reason "lifeline unwind triggered by 5xx>1%"`

deploybot: rollout updated: cb-1765604321 -> 0%.

sara (release-lead): pinning traffic to fallback model as per runbook.

mike (platform): `redwoodctl routing set --service svc-llm-prod-east --model redwood-ocelot-v1 --weight 100` executed. cache purge in progress.

ops-runbook-bot: post-action checklist: 1) confirm error rate returns to baseline 2) capture logs + sample prompts 3) open postmortem if customer impact >5min or >10% error spike. template: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/template

ajay (serving): 5xx falling to 0.15% within 4m of unwind. latency p95 back to +12ms. collecting debug bundle now and saving to artifacts/1765604321.zip

kelly (oncall): good. marking incident as contained. leaving follow-up tasks in the runbook for root-cause investigation.

sara (release-lead): thanks team. we'll block further rollout until RCA and a canary dry-run checklist item is cleared. please add notes to release notes: "canary for v3.2.1 rolled back via lifeline, traffic routed to redwood-ocelot-v1; investigating latency regression"

mike (platform): added release note draft and linked the debug bundle.

deploybot: rollback complete and canary terminated (cb-1765604321). closing thread if no objections. :white_check_mark:

sara (release-lead): no objections. closing. follow-up async: @ajay to own RCA, @mike to validate model binary compatibility tests, @kelly to confirm oncall runbook edits.

(ends)
